name: recall_missing_null_check
about: A None guard is removed, so an anonymous user now raises instead of rendering as a guest.
diff:
diff --git a/profile.py b/profile.py
--- a/profile.py
+++ b/profile.py
@@ -1,4 +1,2 @@
 def display_name(user):
-    if user is None:
-        return "guest"
     return user.first_name + " " + user.last_name

findings.title: user can be None here and will raise AttributeError
